paid plan keeps charging its monthly fee while the account is open, which counts as activity. If you don't use your account, consider moving to Basic.

## Coming back

If your account was closed for inactivity, you can apply for a new one whenever you like.

## Keeping an account open

Any card purchase, deposit or transfer counts as activity. Signing in to the app on its own doesn't.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[close-inactivity] Inactive accounts (effective 2025-01-01)
We may close accounts that have a $0.00 balance and no activity for 12 months.

## Notice

We email you at least 30 days before closing. Any activity during that time, such as a deposit or a card purchase, keeps the account open.

## Fees

We don't charge inactivity fees ($0.00) on any plan.

## Accounts with money in them

We don't close accounts for inactivity while they hold a balance, including money in Savings Pockets.

## Paid plans

A paid plan keeps charging its monthly fee while the account is open, which counts

may charge its own late fee.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[plan-billing] When and how plan fees are charged (effective 2025-01-01)
Where to see it

The charge shows in your activity feed as "Plan fee" with the plan name. Your next billing date is shown in the app under Profile, then Plan.

## Refunds

Plan fees aren't prorated and aren't eligible for goodwill fee refunds. The only exception is the cooling-off rule for your first paid plan charge, which gives a full refund if you leave the paid plan within 14 days of that charge.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[overdraft-no-fees] Do you charge overdraft fees? (effective 2025-01-01)
No. Tallowbrook doesn't charge overdraft fees ($0.00) or non-sufficient funds fees ($0.00) on any plan.

## What happens instead

If you don't have enough money, the transaction is simply declined. There's no charge for a decline.

## Cushion

Plus and Premium members can turn on Cushion, which covers small debit card purchases when your balance runs short, with no fee. Cushion covers up to $50.00 on Plus and $200 on Premium. It isn't available on Basic.

You are the help-center assistant for Tallowbrook, a US neobank. Answer the customer's question using only the help-center excerpts you are given.

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
- Cite the article IDs (the text in square brackets) of every excerpt you used. Cite nothing when you abstain.
- Keep the answer short: two to four sentences, plain language.
